access_links.label: Florida's Community Resiliency Initiative on the U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit

description: Florida's Community Resiliency Initiative is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Climate Adaptation Knowledge Exchange (CAKE); Florida Department of Environmental Protection. In January 2011, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration approved the Florida Coastal Management Program’s Coastal Zone Enhancement Grant (Section 309), which supported the statewide Community Resiliency Initiative, coordinated by the Florida Department of Economic Opportunity. Coverage: Florida (2011). The toolkit gives Florida as the location, 2011 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
